<ApiTitle method="get" title="Get Embedded Signing Settings" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/embedded-signing-settings"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns what your organization allows for embedded signing and identity verification, so your integration can check before it sends or requests a signing URL. It is read-only; an administrator changes these settings in TurboDocx.

  title={"Body"}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
